name: cmdk-engine
description: The smart command palette engine for React. Built on cmdk.

paragraphs: Permission-aware command palette engine for React. Works with cmdk or Base UI. Auto-discover routes, fuzzy search with synonyms, RBAC filtering, frecency ranking, CLI tooling. The Quick Start stack (provider, register hook, cmdk adapter and shortcut) is about 8.3 kB min + brotli on top of React and cmdk.
Live demo: press Cmd+K (Ctrl+K) on the docs site. Runnable apps are in Examples.
Docs: Getting started, the full guide (everything on one page), API reference.
features: Route discovery: turn your React Router config into commands at runtime, or scan a React Router or Next.js app with the CLI. React Router, Next.js, CLI
Access control: show each user only the commands they can use, with permissions in any/all modes and when checks. RBAC
Search: fuzzy matching that tolerates typos, takes words in any order and ignores accents, plus synonyms. Or plug in match-sorter or your own engine. Search, Synonyms
Ranking: frecency puts frequent and recent commands first, with a Recent group. Commands for the current page get a boost, and ties keep a stable order. Frecency, Context boosting
Nested commands and groups: sub-menus with breadcrumbs, and group headings in the order you choose. Nested commands, Groups
